newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BANK RESULTS SEND SHARES UP, FOREKS DIPS.
newsitem.headline: BANK RESULTS SEND SHARES UP, FOREKS DIPS.

text.p: The first releases of banks' April
results raised the market on Tuesday morning and dealers said
the market might go up further.
Hoiupank, Forekspank and leading bank Hansapank have all
released April profit figures, with only Foreks showing a slight
fall.
Hoiupank gained the most after its profit figures as it also
told Reuters that it is to increased its 1997 forecast.
Dealers said the bank figures were strong as expected.
"Hoiupank had best growth, which is a very positive figure
and profits are expected to stay stable," said one analyst.
It was 2.15 kroons higher at 131 kroons in early trade after
hitting a high of 134 kroons.
Dealers said the bank results may also help the market mood
in general.
"The market might do a slight upward move as private
investors catch up with news," a dealer said.
"The bank results made for some short-term excitement and
deeper analysis may also have a positive impact in long-term,"
said one analyst.
"Even if it is not a start of a rise, it will help to
decrease the small selling pressure, which may come by early
summer," he added.
Forekspank shares lost slightly, standing 0.50 kroons down
at 190.50, after reporting lower profits and a fall in assets.
"It seems that investors awaited a better result from
Forekspank and the decrease in assets might be a factor," one
dealer said.
But an analyst said that the Forekspank share fall was only
slight and it was expected to stay at the level of yesterday.
Hansapank's April profit was moderately higher as expected,
dealers said. Its shares were 1.59 kroons higher at 139.59
kroons.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn Newsroom, +372 630 8400,
